The fitting results show that all mechanisms have relatively similar negative log-likelihood (NLL) values, indicating that the current data does not strongly distinguish between them. M17 has the lowest NLL, but the differences are not significant enough to rule out other mechanisms. The initial experiment did not provide sufficient discrimination.

To design the next experiment, I will consider conditions that might amplify the differences between the mechanisms. Since many mechanisms involve catalyst-substrate interactions, varying the initial substrate and catalyst concentrations could be informative. Additionally, some mechanisms involve catalyst dimerization or inhibition, so exploring different catalyst concentrations may help differentiate these.

</reflection>
